title: Breaking feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.20981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose time series encoders promise a single backbone that generalises across tasks and domains; however, they currently do not scale. We trace this down to a critical point of failure: under the predominant masked data modelling supervision, the encoder's output tokens partially collapse. This is the natural consequence of supervising encoders only in the input space, which leaves no constraint against redundant token dimensions in the feature space. We introduce OTISv2, which suppresses the collapse by complementing the reconstruction objective in input space with two objectives in the feature space: a self-distillation loss against an exponential-moving-average teacher, and a KoLeo regulariser. translated_title: 打破自监督时间序列编码器中的特征坍缩
translated_abstract: 通用时间序列编码器有望提供一个能在不同任务和领域间泛化的单一骨干网络；然而，它们目前无法有效扩展规模。我们将这一问题追溯到一个关键的失败点：在主流的掩载数据建模监督下，编码器的输出token会发生部分坍缩。这是仅在输入空间对编码器进行监督的自然结果，这种方式对特征空间中冗余的token维度没有任何约束。我们提出OTISv2，通过在输入空间重建目标的基础上补充两个特征空间目标来抑制坍缩：一个是针对指数移动平均教师的自蒸馏损失，另一个是KoLeo正则化器。在匹配的训练条件下，所得编码器相比其前代模型降低了输出token的余弦相似度并提升了有效秩，且能从7.1M参数到116M参数实现单调的性能扩展，而其前代模型则无法做到这一点。
tldr: 该论文提出OTISv2，通过在特征空间引入自蒸馏损失和KoLeo正则化器来抑制自监督时间序列编码器的特征坍缩问题，使编码器能够从7.1M参数单调扩展至116M参数并保持性能提升。
en_tdlr: OTISv2 breaks feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders by complementing input-space reconstruction with feature-space objectives (EMA-teacher self-distillation and a KoLeo regularizer), enabling monotonic scaling from 7.1M to 116M parameters.
